label: WATCH
rationale: ISRG is an Emerging Outlier-quality business with an unusually strong installed-base/consumables/service flywheel, high recurring revenue, global procedure runway, da Vinci 5/SP/Ion optionality, and a fortress balance sheet. The constraint is price rather than business quality: at $369.83 the market still embeds roughly 11%-13% ten-year FCF growth depending on terminal assumptions, while the base valuation produces only high-single-digit upside. Wait for either a larger margin of safety or additional evidence that FCF per share can compound above the market-implied rate.
increase_evidence: Price falls to at least ~20% below a conservatively updated base intrinsic value without thesis deterioration.
Da Vinci procedure growth remains >=14% globally with OUS growth >=18% while system utilization and recurring revenue remain strong.
Da Vinci 5 OUS rollout broadens materially and SP/Ion procedure growth converts into recurring revenue without margin dilution.
LTM FCF per share compounds at a mid-teens rate after accounting for share-based compensation and lease-related capital intensity.
Competitive pressure remains localized rather than spreading from China into core U.S. and European hospital accounts.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: Sustained global da Vinci procedure growth below 10% without a temporary macro or reimbursement explanation.
Material erosion in I&A revenue per procedure, recurring revenue share, or service economics indicating weaker ecosystem monetization.
Repeated competitive tender/account losses across major U.S. or European health systems.
Material product-safety, regulatory, antitrust, or reimbursement developments that impair the closed-loop instruments/service model.
FCF per share stagnates or declines for multiple years despite continued heavy reinvestment.
Price materially exceeds updated bull/base value without a commensurate improvement in long-duration fundamentals.
